text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I want you to come to the beach 
alone this evening!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was stopped in my tracks right in the 
middle of enjoying the Summer Walk. 
Wondering if she was inviting me to 
train...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Let's party hard!! And deepen our bonds 
like crazy!! We're on a Summer Walk, after 
all!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you made it! Let's get right to 
playing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes! This is my resort uniform! You've 
gotta read the room and dress for the 
occasion!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Heheh! City and the others helped 
me pick this out! They've got amazing 
taste after all, don't they?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, we're all fired up thanks to our 
uniforms! Let's go have some proper 
vacation fun!
choice_data_list:
I was a little surprised that it was an 
invitation to hang out.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe. The truth is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just you, Bamboo? Where's your 
Trainer? Weren't you together?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
We're not together right now! But she 
watched over my training this morning!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No waaaay! Pump it up MORE, YO! This is a 
super-duper rare event, y'know~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! You gotta use opportunities 
like this to deepen your bond with your 
Trainer! Go make some memories!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Deepen our bond, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yup! We're partners, after all! We should 
get to know all sorts of things about each 
other!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Just get it done and it's all gucci! Build 
those bonds while having fun~☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you want, how about we teach you 
instead? We're total pros at that sort of 
thing♪

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
So with that said! To deepen our bond, I 
asked them to teach me all sorts of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Like spending time just the two of us on 
the beach at sunset! Or going to a fancy 
cafe!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Mejiro Palmer and the others probably 
wanted her to fully enjoy the vacation. If 
so, let's make sure she has the absolute 
best time!"
choice_data_list: Okay, shall we get going then?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? You'll show me around, Trainer? 
Thanks a bunch!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ That was delicious! I'm completely 
stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Umm, then next... Shall we go play outside 
or something?
choice_data_list:
Let's relax and make casual small talk 
once in a while.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I get it!! That's nice once in a 
while. Got it!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Umm, then... oh, I know! They've got a lot 
of unusual dishes here! Just a second ago, 
there was a shrimp sticking out of a 
glass!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
How do you eat this? With a fork? Bare 
hands? I've got no clue!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Huh...? My voice is... echoing like 
crazy...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Ah, no! Um... it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(This is bad... I feel like I'm totally 
out of place...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(When I look around, pretty much everyone 
here is an adult, aren't they...?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(...What should I even talk about...? It's 
not like I can make mature 
conversation...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(Aah! In the end, I couldn't get a word in 
at the cafe!)
choice_data_list:
Enjoying the scenery once in a while isn't 
bad at all.

Enjoying the scenery once in a while isn't 
bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah... Yes! Totally! The view is 
awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
(The view, huh... Ummm... I see an island? 
No wait, what's the point of talking about 
that...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Um! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm super sorry!! I guess...! It might be 
too early for me to play around like this!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I wanna deepen our bond and climb our way 
up the Twinkle Series, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm... still just a kid...!!
choice_data_list:
No need to get so worked up about it, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Aw man~...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? Palmer and Helios!? Why are you 
here!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean~, how could I not be curious?? It's 
Bamboo's date☆

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A date?! Huh? But you said it was to 
deepen our bond...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's just a figure of speech, a figure of 
speech! Spending time together as just the 
two of us counts as a date too, right?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just saying, I only wanted Bamboo to 
enjoy her vacation!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
First off, no point just sitting around 
moping! Let's all bond together☆
choice_data_list: Then let's go play and get moving!
Then let's go play and get some exercise!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For Bamboo Memory, getting active and 
playing around should make for the 
ultimate vacation.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's play beach volleyball 
together! I'm not gonna lose, you hear 
me?!
